hero.sub: Heike and Erik work independently on modern web applications and digital products. Direct, pragmatic and with real technical ownership.

people.title: Two profiles. Different strengths.
people.body: Heike and Erik work independently as software developers. Choose the profile that best fits your project and contact the right person directly.

services.eyebrow: What you can hire us for
services.title: Software expertise for your product.
services.body: From key product decisions to long-term development: you work directly with the people who design and build your software.

items.title: Product & web development
items.text: We build maintainable web applications and digital products – from focused interfaces to stable technical delivery.

items.title: Architecture & modernization
items.text: We create clear structures and evolve existing software without throwing away valuable knowledge.

items.title: AI integration & quality
items.text: We combine useful AI support with testing, code reviews and clear human accountability.

collaboration.title: Work with the profile that fits your product.
collaboration.statement: Engage Heike or Erik directly – based on the task and your project.

items.text: You work directly with Heike or Erik on a clearly defined part of your project.

items.text: The selected developer joins your existing product or development team.

work.title: Real work, real evidence.
work.body: Selected projects, published with the approval of our clients.

testimonials.title: Trusted through direct collaboration.
testimonials.body: Recommendations from clients who worked with us directly. They were written in German – translated here, with the originals on LinkedIn.

process.title: How we build reliable software.
process.statement: AI can speed up development. Experience, careful review and clear ownership are what make it reliable.
process.body: Our process runs from the first conversation to software in production. AI supports us where it genuinely helps – decisions and responsibility stay with us.
